source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white while cars are in view)
pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left pixel; headings/angles in image coords (0 deg = +x/right, 90 deg = +y/down)
view: top-down (bird's-eye) orthographic-looking view of a winding two-lane road; cars move in the ground plane, which faces the camera. Car pixel length is constant along the whole path (dark 114.5-117.1 px, silver 124-127 px, 10-90 pct), so one metres-per-pixel scale applies everywhere.

camera.evidence: background frames 61-71 identical (mean abs diff <= 0.02 grey levels); simulation clips use a fixed camera; car frames have a white background so no background check is possible there, but car sizes stay constant and paths follow the road seen in frames 61-71

segments.frames_0_60: white background, only the two cars visible (segmentation)
segments.frames_61_71: full rendered background (road, grass, trees), no cars in view (both have left through the bottom edge)

reference_point: ref_x_px/ref_y_px in the track files = centre of a rigid template (the car's full convex-hull silhouette from a clean frame) fitted to each frame's mask (translation + rotation). This is the centre of the car's top-view footprint (= vehicle origin/root projected, assuming the root is at the footprint centre). Equals the mask centroid within ~1 px on clean frames; also valid for clipped and occluded frames.

events.what: both cars already on the road, partly clipped by the top edge (dark frames 0-3, silver frames 0-4)

frames 0 and 1 are (almost) identical: centre shift 0.4 px (dark) / 0.8 px (silver) vs ~27 / ~22 px per frame afterwards. Motion is visible from frame 1->2 on; likely a duplicated first render frame rather than a real start from rest (no acceleration phase is seen: frame 1->2 step already 26.7 / 21.5 px)
car_dark reaches its right-most point (x = 819.7) while turning from heading ~38 deg (down-right) to down-left; heading 90 deg (straight down) at about frame 14-15
car_silver reaches its right-most point (x = 754.6); heading 90 deg at about frame 18-19
car_dark maximum heading ~128 deg (frames 30-36, inflection of the S-curve), then turns back toward ~100 deg (more downward) before exiting
car_silver maximum heading ~129 deg (frames 39-45), then turns back to ~105 deg before exiting
car_dark passes under the roadside tree canopy: occluded/mask holes frames 31-35
car_dark starts leaving through the bottom edge; last visible frame 49; gone from frame 50
car_silver starts leaving through the bottom edge; last visible frame 60; gone from frame 61
background (road/trees) becomes visible, no cars in frames 61-71

motion_character: both cars drive along the road at near-constant pixel step (dark ~27 px/frame, silver ~22 px/frame; frame-to-frame scatter ~+-1 px), so the gap between them grows from ~87 px (frame 0) to ~218 px (frame 48). No contacts or collisions.
